title: Temple Theme Kit inner pages, group E: Book as a page of TempleKitInner blocks and the shared SpaceBooking block
detail: The page builder for the design's Book page: a hero, three session types as the shared TempleKitInnerService rows pointing at /book, the shared SpaceBooking button (it reads the Space's own booking state) and a questions block. No new booking engine: the site serves the real booking page at /book once the Space has times open. No price is seeded. Registration (page list) belongs to the Temple kit registration pass.

verify.evidence: pages-e.ts exports the Book page and puts SpaceBooking on it.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("components/sites/temple-kit-inner/pages-e.ts","utf8");if(!t.includes("templeKitBookPage")||!t.includes("SpaceBooking")){console.error("the Temple Kit Book page is missing");process.exit(1)}'
